name: Nampak Limited
source: Nampak Limited audited consolidated financial results for the year ended 30 September 2025 (continuing operations), consolidated statement of comprehensive income, figures printed in R million and stored in absolute ZAR: https://www.nampak.com/Documents/About/integrated-report-2025.pdf and https://senspdf.jse.co.za/documents/SENS_20251208_S514507.pdf . FY2025 column re-collected from that statement because the stored cells did not tie: Operating Expenses 2,359.4 is employee benefit 1,364.2 plus depreciation 267.5 plus net expected credit losses 23.4 plus other operating expenses 1,423.1 less other operating income 367.6 less net impairment loss reversals 351.2; Operating Profit 1,944.8 is the printed operating profit; Net Finance Costs 508.0 is finance costs 555.1 less finance income 47.1; Profit Before Tax 1,436.8 and Income Tax 277.2 are printed; Net Profit 1,159.6 is profit for the year from continuing operations, which is Profit Before Tax less Income Tax. The prior cells (Operating Expenses 2,947.7, Operating Profit 1,356.5, Net Finance Costs 551.5, Profit Before Tax and Net Profit empty) came from a secondary feed and left the column unable to tie. Per-share figures are NOT changed here: the EPS row is stored in rand per share, so 410.101 is the printed diluted total-operations loss/earnings per share of 41 010.1 cents. Read 2026-10-19.
